risk_note: RV2 identity payout account binding (B1-27a money r1 S2; ruling D10-1077 ③; no money moves). During the vendor call of a bank-card verification, outside every lock, customer service could complete a real-name correction (same name, new ID number); the vendor's match for the old identity was then bound under the new one. saveBankCard now compares, under the users row lock that the correction also takes and after every existing check, the verification record's reserved_at with the realname row's verified_at (row_version > 0 and strictly earlier): nothing is written, the record is settled matched on its own write, and the answer is 40901, not stored. Retrying with a new Idempotency-Key costs one more paid verification (accepted by D10-1077 ③, the interleaving is rare); the same key gets 20901 as before. Callers without a verification record (Alipay) are unchanged. No migration, no contract change. Integration bank-card-correction-race plus the frozen payout-account, payout-bank-card, payout-verify-recheck, admin-realname and realname-payout-invalidate directories 290/290; tsc 0.
